system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

The Senju are known for their inhuman stamina and vitality. Increase your Hit Point total by 2. Every level thereafter, increase your hit point total by 2.

Additionally, this well of vitality coalesces within you as latent self-restoring energies. You have a well of these healing energies called Senju Cells, of which you have 2.

Once per turn, at the beginning of your turn, while you are not incapacitated, you can call upon this healing energy and spend 1 Senju Cell. When you do, roll 1d6 + your half your level, minimum 1. You regain hit points equal to the result. You regain spent Senju Cells when you complete a rest.

Beginning at 7th level, increase the total number of Senju Cells you have to 4. Also, at the beginning of your turn, you can spend 1 Senju Cell to end any one Physical or Elemental condition you have.

Beginning at 15th level, increase the total number of Senju Cells you have to 6. Also, if you begin your turn with 0 hit points, you can spend any number of Senju Cells to spend an equal number of Hit Die, regaining hit points equal to the result.
